title: Build It Fast (StringBuilder)
statementMd:
Joining text with `+` inside a loop copies the whole string every round — O(n²). A **StringBuilder** changes one buffer instead.

Join the words with `-` between them, then print the joined text and its length.

**Input**
Line 1: `n`. Line 2: n words separated by spaces.

**Output**
Line 1: the words joined by `-`. Line 2: `Length: <characters>`.

Build the answer with a StringBuilder (`append`), not with `+` in the loop.
hints: sb.append(x) adds to the end and returns the same builder, so calls can be chained.
Add the separator only when i > 0, so the first word has nothing in front of it. sb.length() is the character count.
